provenance: written by bin/train.py by training leave-one-specimen-out over the specimens the handoff holds, so every number in this document is a function of that handoff, of the weights bin/label_patches.py wrote, of the resolved parameters under `config`, and of the seed `config` carries. **Each fold's figure is the epoch with the highest validation F1, and that validation set is the held-out specimen the figure is reported over**: with three specimens there is no third split, so every per-fold metric here is the best of up to `training.epochs` attempts on the very patches it is measured on and is an upper bound rather than an estimate of performance on unseen tissue. `summary.epoch_selection` records how many epochs each fold considered, which it chose and the mean over the ones it did not, and the per-epoch values are in `training_log_fold<n>.csv` beside this file. The labels those figures are measured against are morphological blob counts and not a pathologist's grade, so the ceiling is agreement with a hand-tuned counter
